name: Lineage
desc: A body of ideas that changes how you understand systems. It informs action without prescribing it.

name: Practice
desc: A way of being together that shifts perception and relationship. It works indirectly and breaks when aimed at an output.

name: Method
desc: A structured process with steps and artifacts, aimed at a designed outcome. It can be commissioned and reported on.

name: Structure
desc: An arrangement of authority, decision-making, and feedback. It changes who decides and how information flows.

name: Field
desc: A domain where lineages, practices, methods, and structures meet a context. It is where you work, not how.

name: Tradition
desc: A whole way of knowing held by peoples and places. It enters through relationship, consent, and shared power.

name: Hybrid
desc: A pathway that is several kinds at once. Watch for the method part being taken and the rest dropped.
